title: A plan for a walk

turns.speaker: speaker
turns.text: 昨日は朝、公園を散歩しました。三十分歩きました。朝は涼しかったですが、昼はとても暑かったです。
turns.translation: Yesterday I took a walk in the park in the morning. I walked for thirty minutes. The morning was cool, but midday was very hot.

turns.speaker: speaker
turns.text: 今日も暑いですから、昼は家にいます。散歩は夕方六時からにします。
turns.translation: It's hot today too, so I'll stay home at midday. I'll take my walk from six in the evening.

turns.speaker: speaker
turns.text: 今日は二十分ぐらい歩きます。出かける前に、水をかばんに入れます。
turns.translation: Today I'll walk for about twenty minutes. Before going out, I'll put some water in my bag.
